There are so many good recipes out there, but truthfully I’ve always had a hard time finding one that actually works for the season of life I’m in. My husband works late and I have two little girls, so weeknight dinner is on me, and most nights I just don’t have the time, the energy, or the headspace for a lot of recipes. That’s pretty much why I started making my own dinners, and I hope other moms, or honestly anyone, can appreciate them, because to me they’re actually so easy. DUMB DINNERS Broccoli Cheddar Chicken Orzo INGREDIENTS 1 box (16 oz) orzo, uncooked 1 tub (32 oz) Panera broccoli cheddar soup 2 cups low-sodium chicken broth 3 cups shredded rotisserie chicken 1 tsp garlic powder ½ tsp black pepper a few shakes Frank’s RedHot 1 bag (12 oz) frozen broccoli florets 1 bag (8 oz) shredded extra-sharp cheddar a big handful Cheez-Its, crushed HOW TO MAKE IT Heat the oven to 375°F. Spray a 9×13 dish. Dump in the orzo, soup, broth, and chicken. Sprinkle on the garlic powder, pepper, and hot sauce. Dump in the frozen broccoli straight from the bag. Stir well so the orzo is under the liquid. Cover tightly with foil. Bake at 375°F for 40 minutes. Uncover and stir. It should look loose and creamy. Stir in half the cheddar. Top with the rest, then the crushed Cheez-Its. Bake uncovered 5 more minutes. Let it sit 10 minutes before serving. Taste before adding any salt. #creatorsearchinsights #easydinnerideas #easyrecipe #easymeal #dinnerideas

Garlic honey butter ribeye bites with creamy mash and tender heirloom carrots 🥩✨ A 10/10 meal!! - juicy seared steak bites served over creamy silky mash, heirloom carrots, with a heavvvvenly garlic honey butter drizzled over it all.  Enjoy!     Steak bites (makes 2 servings) * 2 boneless ribeyes, about 1–1½ pounds (450–680 g) total * 1 tablespoon avocado oil, 15 ml, plus more if needed * ½ teaspoon fine salt, 3 g, or to taste * ½ teaspoon freshly cracked black pepper * 1 tsp paprika * 1 tsp garlic powder * 1 tsp onion powder  Garlic honey butter * 4-5 tbsps unsalted butter * 5 garlic cloves, 15 g, minced or finely chopped  * 3-4 tbsps honey, more or less to taste  * 1-2 teaspoons soy sauce sauce * 1 tbsp fresh thyme chopped * 1/2 tsp red pepper chili flakes (optional) * 1 tablespoon chopped fresh parsley, 4 g * Freshly cracked black pepper * Salt, to taste Tender heirloom carrots * 6-8 heirloom carrots, peeled, washed, stems cut * 1 tablespoon avocado oil, 15 ml * Splash of water  * ¼ teaspoon fine salt * Black pepper, to taste Creamy mash  * 6-7 gold potatoes, peeled, rinsed, boiled  * 3-4 tbsps unsalted butter * 1/4 cup heavy cream, more or less for desired consistency  * Salt and pepper to taste  Instructions pinned in the comments  #steak #foodie #explore #recipe  1. Pan sear carrots on medium heat until fork tender. Set aside.  2. Peel, rinse, cut potatoes into large chunks and boil them in salted water until fork tender. Drain and steam dry for 10 minutes.  3. Mash potatoes with a ricer or mixer (on low speed) until smooth.  4. Heat the mash on low heat in a pot adding the heavy cream, butter, salt and pepper to taste. Set aside and keep warm.  5. Trim away any large, hard pieces of exterior fat, pat steaks dry. Cut into 1 inch bite sized pieces, season.  6. Sear the steak bites in batches in a cast iron or skillet over medium high heat for 1 minute flipping each piece over halfway through. Do not overcrowd the pan for even searing. Remove the steak bites and set aside. 7. In the same pan clean off any black residue from the steak, keeping the browned pan drippings. Add the butter and garlic, stirring it around for 1 min on medium heat. Add the honey, followed by the rest of the garlic honey butter ingredients until glossy.  8. Return steak bites back to the pan and continue to cook in the garlic honey butter for another minute or two or until it’s cooked to your liking.

This isn't a scene from a film. This is a heartbreaking reality that still exists in parts of Nepal. For some women and girls, getting their period means being sent away from their own home to spend the night in a small shed, away from their families. They are left to face cold nights, fear, loneliness, and the danger of snakes, insects, and wild animals—all because of a natural biological process. Menstruation should never be a reason for exclusion or shame. Take a moment and ask yourself: If it were someone you love—your daughter, your sister, your wife, or your mother—would you accept this as "tradition"? Some customs deserve to be questioned, especially when they put lives and dignity at risk. Every woman deserves to feel safe, respected, and valued, no matter what day of the month it is. Let's raise awareness, start conversations, and stand together to end harmful practices like this. EASY RECIPE BELOW👇😋 𝐂𝐫𝐞𝐚𝐦𝐲 𝐒𝐦𝐨𝐭𝐡𝐞𝐫𝐞𝐝 𝐂𝐡𝐢𝐜𝐤𝐞𝐧 & 𝐑𝐢𝐜𝐞  …this one is PURE comfort food & so easy 🥹🍗🍚 the sauce is rich, herby, a little spice, and so good poured over fluffy rice!!🤍✨ ⸻ 𝐈𝐧𝐠𝐫𝐞𝐝𝐢𝐞𝐧𝐭𝐬: 𝐅𝐨𝐫 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐂𝐡𝐢𝐜𝐤𝐞𝐧: • 2 lbs chicken thighs or breasts • 1 tsp salt • ½ tsp black pepper • 1 tsp garlic powder • 1 tsp onion powder • 1 tsp paprika • 1 tsp dried thyme • 1 tsp dried parsley • 2 tbsp olive oil 𝐅𝐨𝐫 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐒𝐚𝐮𝐜𝐞: • 2 tbsp butter • 1 small onion, diced • 3 cloves garlic, minced • 2 cups chicken broth • 1 cup heavy cream • 1 tsp dried thyme • 1 tsp dried parsley • ½ tsp salt • ½ tsp black pepper • ½ tsp red pepper flakes • 1 tsp cornstarch + 1 tbsp water (optional to make it thicker) 𝐅𝐨𝐫 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐑𝐢𝐜𝐞: • 1½ cups long-grain white rice • 3 cups water or chicken broth ⸻  𝐈𝐧𝐬𝐭𝐫𝐮𝐜𝐭𝐢𝐨𝐧𝐬:  1. Season your chicken with salt, pepper, garlic powder, onion powder, paprika, thyme, and parsley. 2. Heat olive oil in a skillet and sear chicken 4–5 minutes per side until golden. Remove it and set aside with foil over it. 3. In the same pan, add olive oil. Add your diced onion and sauté about 3 minutes until soft. Keep stirring so it doesn’t burn. Then add butter & garlic and cook 30 seconds. 4. Pour in chicken broth to deglaze the pan. Stir in heavy cream, thyme, parsley, salt, pepper, and red pepper flakes. Simmer about 5 minutes. (Add cornstarch slurry if you want it thicker.) 5. Return chicken to the sauce. Cover and simmer on low 10–15 minutes until fully cooked and tender. 6. Cook rice separately… bring liquid to a boil, add rinsed rice, cover and cook about 15 minutes. Let sit 5 minutes, then fluff. 7. Serve chicken over rice and spoon extra creamy sauce on top 🤍 #easydinner #dinnerinspo #easyrecipes #chickenandrice #chickenrecipes

Honey Garlic Parmesan Chicken & Potatoes🍗🍯🧀🍟 By far one of the best combos i’ve made, all made around making meal prepping easy and effortless. The chicken is absolutely INCREDIBLE! Macros Per Serving (10 Total) 596 Calories | 54g Protein | 51g Carbs | 19g Fat Ingredients (Makes 10 Servings) Honey Garlic Parmesan Chicken •Marinade - 1500g Raw Boneless Chicken Thighs, cubed - 3 Tsp Salt - 3 Tsp Chilli Flakes - 3 Tsp Paprika - 4 Tsp Parsley - 4 Tsp Garlic Granules or Powder - 4 Tsp Italian Herbs - 130g Grated Parmigiano Reggiano - 45g Honey - 8 Tsp / 40g Olive Oil •After Cooking - Extra 15g Honey - Extra 20g Grated Parmesan - Parsley for garnish Crispy Roasted Potatoes - 1800g Raw White/Yellow Potatoes, cubed - 4 Tsp Paprika - 4 Tsp Onion Powder - 4 Tsp Oregano - Olive Oil Cooking Spray, 5 seconds spray Creamy Parmesan Tuscan Sauce •Blender - 700g Fat Free Cottage Cheese - 250g Skimmed Milk - 250g Light Evaporated Milk •Pan - 30g Light Butter - 200g White Onion, finely chopped - 45g Garlic, finely chopped - 200g Sundried Tomatoes, drained & chopped - Handful Fresh Basil Leaves, roughly chopped - 1 Tsp Salt - 1 Tsp Chilli Flakes - 2 Tsp Italian Herbs - 100g Grated Parmesan - 20g Parmesan Rind Chunks Cooking Instructions 1. Cube chicken thighs. Add seasonings, Parmesan, honey and olive oil. Mix well and set aside. Prepare cream sauce. 2. Cube potatoes and add to a lined sheet pan. Season, spray generously with cooking spray and mix. Spread evenly and bake at 200C / 400F for 35-40 mins until golden and crispy. 3. Meanwhile, melt butter in a large pan over medium heat. Add onion, garlic and sun-dried tomatoes. Cook 10 mins until softened, then add seasonings and fresh basil. 4. Toast 2 mins, then reduce heat to low. Add cream sauce, Parmesan and Parmesan rind. Mix gently until creamy. Do not boil. 5. Remove potatoes. Spread chicken on the same sheet pan and bake at 190C / 380F for 20 mins, then broil/grill 5-6 mins until golden and juicy. Finish with honey and Parmesan. 6. Add crispy potatoes to the cream sauce and gently fold until well coated. Recipe Name: Creamy Spinach Mushroom Chicken Bake Ingredients 1. 6 boneless skinless chicken thighs or breasts 2. 2 tbsp olive oil 3. 1 tsp salt 4. 1 tsp black pepper 5. 1 tsp garlic powder 6. 8 oz mushrooms, sliced 7. 3 cups fresh spinach 8. 4 cloves garlic, minced 9. 1 cup heavy cream 10. 1/2 cup chicken broth 11. 1 cup mozzarella cheese, shredded 12. 1/2 cup Parmesan cheese, grated 13. 1 tbsp butter 14. 1 tbsp chopped parsley Recipe 1. Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C). 2. Season chicken with salt, pepper, and garlic powder. 3. Sear chicken in olive oil until golden on both sides. 4. Transfer chicken to a baking dish. 5. Melt butter in the skillet and sauté mushrooms until browned. 6. Add garlic and cook 30 seconds. 7. Stir in chicken broth and heavy cream. 8. Simmer for 3 minutes. 9. Add spinach and cook until wilted. 10. Pour sauce over chicken. 11. Top with mozzarella and Parmesan. 12. Bake 20–25 minutes until bubbly. 13. Broil 2 minutes for a golden top. 14. Garnish with parsley and serve. 👉 Follow our account for more delicious recipes every day!

Cheesy Herb Chicken & Baby Potatoes 🥔🍗 Juicy chicken thighs, buttery baby potatoes, and a golden layer of melted cheese. Everything baked together in one dish for an easy, flavorful dinner with minimal cleanup! Ingredients (4 servings): * 4–5 boneless, skinless chicken thighs * 1.5 lb baby potatoes * 4 tbsp butter, melted * 1 tsp garlic powder * 1 tsp paprika * 1 tsp onion powder * 1 tsp Italian seasoning * 1 tbsp fresh parsley, finely chopped * 1 tsp salt, or to taste * ½ tsp black pepper * ¾–1 cup shredded mozzarella cheese Instructions: 1. Preheat your oven to 400°F (200°C). Arrange the baby potatoes in a parchment-lined baking dish. 2. In a small bowl, combine melted butter, garlic powder, paprika, onion powder, Italian seasoning, parsley, salt, and black pepper. 3. Place the chicken thighs on top of the potatoes and pour the seasoned butter mixture evenly over everything, making sure the chicken and potatoes are well coated. 4. Bake for approximately 35–45 minutes, or until the potatoes are fork-tender and the chicken reaches an internal temperature of 165°F. 5. Sprinkle shredded mozzarella over the chicken and return to the oven for another 5–10 minutes, until the cheese is melted and beautifully golden. 6. Serve warm, spooning some of the buttery herb sauce from the baking dish over the top! Simple ingredients, one baking dish, and a dinner you’ll want to make again! 🤍 #ChickenDinner #EasyDinnerIdeas #OnePanDinner #ChickenRecipes #HomeCooking

🍔 VIRAL GARLIC PARMESAN CHEESEBURGERS 🧄🧀 Don’t make regular cheeseburgers again until you try them served face down in a pool of creamy garlic Parmesan sauce! 😭🔥 Ingredients For the burgers: * 1 lb ground beef (80/20) * 1 small onion, thinly sliced * Salt, pepper, garlic powder & paprika * 4 slices American cheese * 4 burger buns * Butter for toasting For the garlic Parmesan sauce: * 2 tbsp butter * 4 cloves garlic, minced * 1 cup heavy cream * ½ cup freshly grated Parmesan * ½ tsp garlic powder * ½ tsp smoked paprika * ½ tsp Italian seasoning * Salt & pepper to taste * Fresh parsley Instructions 1. Make the smash burgers: Divide beef into 4 portions. Add sliced onions to a hot skillet, place beef on top and smash into thin patties. Season generously. 2. Get those crispy edges: Sear until browned, flip and cook to 160°F. Top with American cheese and let it melt. 3. Make the sauce: Melt butter in a saucepan, sauté garlic until fragrant, then add heavy cream and seasonings. Simmer gently before stirring in Parmesan until smooth and creamy. 4. Toast your buns: Butter and toast until golden, then assemble your cheeseburgers. 5. Now for the best part! Pour a generous layer of warm garlic Parmesan sauce directly onto your serving plate. Cut each cheeseburger in half and place both halves cut side down directly into the sauce, allowing that cheesy goodness to soak into every bite. 6. Finish it off: Surround the burgers with crispy fries, garnish with parsley and serve immediately! PRO TIP: Keep extra garlic Parmesan sauce on the side because you’re going to want to dip EVERYTHING in it. 😂 #GarlicParmesanBurger #CheeseburgerRecipe #SmashBurgers #ViralRecipes #EasyDinnerIdeas

Ragi Roti and Glucose Spike 📉📈 Is Ragi actually the "magical healthy alternative" we all think it is? We put it to the ultimate Continuous Glucose Monitor (CGM) test, and the results were absolutely shocking. 🤯 Yesterday, regular wheat (aata) roti gave us a massive spike, leaving us super stressed. So, we tested the exact same weight of Ragi roti today, expecting much safer numbers. We waited a few hours, checked the monitor, and... trust me, you are not ready for this. My spike was a complete record-breaker—it matched the exact same spike I got from drinking straight pineapple juice!  And my mom's graph? It shot up even higher than the regular wheat roti! 📈 My mom used to have diabetes, but she brought it completely under control two years ago by giving up all types of roti. This test proved exactly why. I even pulled out the packets to compare the nutrition labels, and the truth about Ragi's fiber and net carbs compared to regular wheat will surprise you. The numbers don't lie. Watch the video to see the real-time graph and the final numbers! If you are looking for truly healthy, low-spike alternatives, check out my page for recipes like my Tofu Scramble, Gajar Ka Halwa, and Chocolate Pudding. ✅ Next up: We are testing Bajra ki Roti. VOLCÁN CHOCOLATE 👇receta escrita👇 CLICK @laura.lopez.mon para más recetas fáciles 💥GUÁRDATE💥 esta receta de pastel de chocolate | lava cake, facilísimo de hacer con 5 ingredientes, sin robots ¡nunca falla! ➖➖➖➖➖➖ 📍 INGREDIENTES 4 unidades 200 g chocolate (mínimo 55% de cacao) 70 g mantequilla 4 huevos M 70 g azúcar 50 g harina trigo común (sin levaduras) Para pincelar los moldes : mantequilla y cacao puro en polvo ➖➖➖➖➖➖ 📍ELABORACIÓN 🔹️ Pon en un recipiente el chocolate y la mantequilla y fúndelo. Deja atemperar 5 minutos 🔹️ Mientras pon en un bol los huevos y el azúcar y bate con unas varillas hasta que espumen. Añade el chocolate y mezcla con una espátula hasta que se integre por completo 🔹️ Añade la harina tamizada y mezcla con la espátula hasta que esté perfectamente integrado 🔹️ Pincela los moldes con mantequilla a punto de pomada y espolvorea con cacao en polvo 🔹️ Llena los moldes con la masa hasta 1 cm del borde. Introduce en el congelador 30 minutos 🔹️ Saca del congelador e introduce en el horno precalentado a 220°C durante 12 minutos ⚠️ la temperatura interior de tu horno puede variar respecto a la mía (cada horno es un mundo) por lo que el tiempo de cocción puede variar entre 12 y 15 minutos. Deberás probar variando los minutos hasta conseguir el punto, pero nunca será menos de 12 ni más de 15 🔹️ Saca del horno y deja reposar 2 minutos. Separa la pared con el fijo de un cuchillo y desmolda 🔹️ Sirve inmediatamente ➖➖➖➖➖➖➖ Feliz día 🤗 #lauralopezmon #lavacake #micuitchocolat #volcandechocolate #coulant

The viral beef broth rice bowl 🤎👇 im late to the trend but this bowl has literally become my favorite & that says A LOT. Full of flavor, nutrients, texture, omg. ingredients: 1 cup cooked rice 1 cup beef bone broth 1/3 cup half & half ground beef  1 garlic clove, minced soy sauce, to taste paprika oregano cilantro black pepper tomato paste mustard (IMPORTANT) lemon  green onions + sesame seeds for topping how to make it: 1. Brown the ground beef in a skillet until fully cooked. Add the seasonings on top along with soy sauce and mustard, add tomato paste gradually. 2. Once fully cooked, transfer it to a bowl. 3. Heat a pan and sautee minced garlic until browned, add 1 tbsp of tomato paste 4. heat the beef bone broth in the same saucepan. Cozy & Affordable Baked Chicken Dinner 🍗🤎 Tonight I was going for cozy, comforting, and affordable, and this is one of my go-to dinners when I want something simple but still really good. Ingredients: * Chicken legs * Olive oil * Garlic powder * Onion powder * Paprika * Seasoning salt * Black pepper * Italian seasoning * 1 orange bell pepper, sliced * 1 green bell pepper, sliced * 1 onion, sliced * 2 cans cream of mushroom soup * ½–1 cup chicken broth * Jasmine rice * French-style green beans * Buttermilk biscuits * Honey for glazing Instructions: 1. Season the chicken legs with garlic powder, onion powder, paprika, seasoning salt, black pepper, and Italian seasoning. 2. Drizzle with olive oil and mix well so the seasoning coats the chicken. 3. Slice the peppers and onion. 4. Sauté the peppers and onions in a skillet until they begin to soften. 5. Add the cream of mushroom soup and chicken broth. Stir until smooth and creamy. 6. Place the seasoned chicken in a baking dish and pour the creamy mixture over the top. 7. Bake at 375°F for about 50–60 minutes, or until the chicken reaches 165°F internally and is fully cooked. 8. Serve with jasmine rice, French-style green beans, and a warm buttermilk biscuit finished with a little honey. Affordable, filling, and the perfect comfort dinner. Tender pan-seared chicken, creamy garlic parmesan gravy, and buttery mashed potatoes that soak up every last drop. ✨ 🕒 Total Time: ~45 minutes 🍽️ Serves: 4-6 📋 Ingredients: • 2 lbs chicken breasts, sliced in half lengthwise • 2 tbsp olive oil • 2 tbsp butter • 2 tbsp all-purpose flour • 1½ cups chicken broth • 1 cup heavy cream or half-and-half • ½ cup grated parmesan cheese • Garlic salt • Onion powder • Paprika • Black pepper • Mashed potatoes, for serving 👩🏼‍🍳 Directions: 1. Season chicken generously with garlic salt, onion powder, paprika, and black pepper. 2. Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. 3. Cook chicken 4-5 minutes per side until golden brown and cooked through. Remove from skillet and set aside. 4. Reduce heat to medium. Add butter to the skillet and let melt. 5. Whisk in flour and cook for 1-2 minutes to create a roux. 6. Slowly pour in chicken broth while whisking until smooth and thickened. 7. Stir in heavy cream (or half-and-half) and parmesan cheese. Simmer until the gravy is rich, creamy, and silky smooth. 8. Return the chicken to the skillet and spoon the sauce over top. Simmer for 3-5 minutes. 9. Serve over warm mashed potatoes and drizzle with plenty of that creamy garlic gravy. ✨ This is the kind of dinner that has everyone asking for seconds and a piece of bread to clean the plate. 🤍 #CreamyGarlicChicken #ComfortFood #EasyDinnerRecipe #FamilyDinner

Cheat code meal prep. This Mexican cheesy chicken and rice might be one of my all time favorites so far. Honestly… I totally outdid myself with this one. Add taco seasoning and lime juice and cook until fully done. Mexican rice 1½ cups dry rice 3 cups water 3 tablespoons tomato paste Sazón seasoning 1 sweet onion Saute the onion first. Add the rice and lightly toast it. Then add the water, tomato paste, and sazón seasoning. Bring to a boil, cover, and cook on low for about 10 minutes. High protein queso 2 cups low fat cottage cheese 2 cups shredded jalapeno cheddar 2 tablespoons diced green onion Diced green chili pepper Splash of lime juice Milk to thin Blend the cottage cheese until smooth, then heat with the shredded cheese, green onion, green chili, lime juice, and a little milk until it becomes a creamy queso. Howlin’ Ray’s Nashville Hot Chicken at Home 🔥 Howlin’ Ray’s at Home Part 1/3 Send this to your mom so she can make it for you ❤️‍🔥 Comeback Sauce + Nashville Hot Chicken & Waffles recipes dropping SOON 😎 Full detailed recipes in bio 🔗 — CONDENSED RECIPE 👇 1️⃣ MARINATE: Pound 2 boneless chicken thighs to ½” thick. Whisk 2 cups buttermilk, ½ cup pickle juice, 2 tbsp hot sauce (@Osmo Kitchen magic sauce), 1 egg, kosher salt, garlic powder, onion powder, mustard powder, paprika, white pepper, cayenne & optional MSG. Add thighs + 6 tenders, cover & refrigerate at least 4 hours, ideally overnight. 2️⃣ COMEBACK SAUCE: Mix mayo, ketchup, hot sauce, Dijon, Worcestershire, lemon juice, paprika, garlic powder, onion powder, black pepper & salt. Refrigerate for at least 2 hours. FULL RECIPE DROPPING SOON 🔥 3️⃣ DOUBLE DREDGE: Mix 3 cups flour, 1 cup cornstarch, 1 tbsp baking powder, kosher salt, garlic powder, onion powder, mustard powder, paprika, white pepper, cayenne & optional MSG. Drizzle in 3–4 tbsp chicken marinade and mix to create craggly bits. Dip chicken in marinade → press into flour → rest on a rack for 10 minutes to hydrate flour → repeat marinade + flour before frying. 4️⃣ FRY: Heat neutral oil to 350°F. Fry in batches: tenders about 3–5 minutes; thighs about 5–7 minutes, until golden, CWISPY & 165°F internal. Drain on a clean wire rack. 5️⃣ NASHVILLE HOT OIL: In a heatproof bowl, combine cayenne, paprika, dark brown sugar, garlic powder, onion powder, mustard powder, black pepper, kosher salt & optional MSG. Carefully ladle in 1–1½ cups hot fry oil & whisk for 1-2 minutes to let bloom. Dunk or brush onto chicken. 6️⃣ SERVE: Enjoy with comeback sauce—or pile onto a buttered, toasted brioche bun with slaw, dill pickles & extra sauce. Serve immediately and enjoy, friends :) — #howlinrays #nashvillehotchicken #friedchicken #comebacksauce #recipe

Easy High Protein Honey BBQ Chicken Mac & Cheese🍯🍗🧀 59g Protein Meal Prep💪🏼 (Macros Per Serve, Makes 4 Servings) 587 Calories 67.5gC | 9gF | 59gP Like recipes like this? Check out my cookbooks! LINK IS IN MY BIO 👨🏻‍🍳📚 Ingredients: * 700g Diced Chicken Breast (raw weight) * 1 Tsp Each: Salt, Onion Powder, Smoked Paprika & Garlic Powder * 1 Tsp Olive Oil * 25g Honey * 85g Reduced Sugar or Sugar Free BBQ Sauce (Hughes Sugar Free BBQ Sauce or your preferred BBQ sauce) * 320g Macaroni Pasta (uncooked weight) * 340ml Fat Free Evaporated Milk (Carnation Light & Creamy 99% Fat Free) * 80g Light Cream Cheese * 1.5 Tsp Chicken Stock Powder * 100g Grated Light Cheddar Cheese (Dairyworks Natural Cheddar) Instructions: 1. Add the diced chicken breast to a bowl and season with salt, onion powder, smoked paprika & garlic powder. Drizzle over the olive oil and mix thoroughly until every piece is evenly coated in the seasonings. 2. Heat a pan over medium heat and add the seasoned chicken. Cook for approximately 4 minutes on each side or until golden on the outside and fully cooked through. 3. Reduce the heat to low, then add the honey and BBQ sauce directly to the pan. Toss the chicken through the sauce until every piece is coated in a thick & sticky honey BBQ glaze. Remove from the heat and set aside. 4. Meanwhile bring a pot of salted water to a boil and cook the macaroni according to the packet instructions until al dente. Drain the pasta and set aside. 5. For the cheese sauce add the evaporated milk, light cream cheese and chicken stock powder to a separate pan over medium low heat. Stir until the cream cheese has softened and combined with the milk then gradually add the grated cheddar. Continue stirring until melted into a smooth, rich & creamy cheese sauce. 6. Add the drained macaroni directly into the cheese sauce and mix everything together until the pasta is completely coated in that creamy, cheesy goodness. 7. Divide the honey BBQ chicken and mac & cheese evenly between 4 meal prep containers. Finish with some freshly chopped parsley if desired and enjoy! Meal Prep Pro Tip: Mac & Cheese naturally thickens as it cools because the pasta continues absorbing moisture from the sauce. When reheating add a small splash of milk and give everything a good stir to bring back that smooth, creamy consistency! Store in airtight containers in the fridge for up to 3 to 4 days, or freeze individual portions for longer storage. #macandcheese #mealprep #highprotein #healthyrecipes #chickenmacandcheese

Ingredients: 2 tbsp oil 3 bone-in, skin-on chicken legs, separated Salt 15 cloves garlic 3 bay leaves 1 tbsp black peppercorns 1 cup water 1/2 cup soy sauce 1/2 cup rice vinegar 2 tbsp honey 2 tbsp oil 8 cloves of garlic 2 cups of cooked rice Salt, sugar, MSG Directions 1. Heat oil in a heavy pot or Dutch oven over medium heat. Pat chicken dry and season lightly with salt. 2. Sear chicken in a single layer skin side down, 6-7 minutes until well browned. Flip and cook another 3 minutes, then set aside. 3. In the same pot, add garlic, bay leaves, and peppercorns. Stir constantly until fragrant and garlic is lightly golden, about 30 seconds.  4. Deglaze with water, scraping up all the brown bits.  5. Add soy sauce, vinegar, and honey, then return chicken to the pot, and bring to a boil. Reduce to low, cover, and simmer 20 minutes, flipping halfway through. 6. For garlic fried rice, add oil to a pan, and sautee garlic until golden. 7. Add rice, and season with salt, sugar, and MSG. 8. Serve chicken adobo over garlic fried rice.

Ornamental grasses do particularly well in the Northeast because many varieties are naturally adapted to cold winters, seasonal changes, and a wide range of soil conditions. Their deep, extensive root systems help them tolerate periods of summer heat and drought once established, while their dormant crowns allow them to survive freezing temperatures and return reliably each spring. Many grasses also thrive in the Northeast’s full sun and well-drained soils and require relatively little maintenance compared with many flowering plants. Recipe Name: Garlic Parmesan Baked Chicken Breasts Ingredients 1. 4 boneless skinless chicken breasts (2 lbs) 2. 3 tbsp olive oil 3. 4 cloves garlic, minced 4. 1 tsp salt 5. 1/2 tsp black pepper 6. 1 tsp paprika 7. 1 tsp dried thyme 8. 1 tsp dried rosemary 9. 1 cup Parmesan cheese, grated 10. 2 tbsp fresh parsley, chopped 11. 2 tbsp butter, melted 12. 1 tbsp lemon juice Recipe 1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). 2. Pat chicken breasts dry with paper towels. 3. Mix olive oil, garlic, lemon juice, and melted butter in a bowl. 4. Season chicken with salt, pepper, paprika, thyme, and rosemary. 5. Place chicken in a greased baking dish. 6. Brush the garlic mixture evenly over each chicken breast. 7. Sprinkle Parmesan cheese generously on top. 8. Bake for 25–30 minutes until chicken reaches 165°F internally. 9. Spoon pan juices over the chicken halfway through cooking. 10. Broil for 2–3 minutes for a golden crust. 11. Remove from oven and rest for 5 minutes. 12. Garnish with fresh parsley. 13. Serve with vegetables, rice, or potatoes. 14. Enjoy while hot. 👉 Follow our account for more delicious recipes every day!

Save this one because you probably already have most of what you need. Ingredients: 3 cups cooked, shredded chicken 1 (10.5 oz) can cream of chicken soup 1 cup sour cream 1½ cups shredded cheddar cheese 1 sleeve Ritz crackers, crushed Directions: 1. Preheat oven to 350°F and grease a 9-inch square baking dish. 2. Mix the chicken, cream of chicken soup and sour cream. 3. Spread half the chicken mixture in the dish and top with half the cheese. 4. Add the remaining chicken mixture, then the rest of the cheese. 5. Top with the crushed Ritz crackers. 6. Bake for about 30 minutes, until hot and bubbly and the top is golden brown. 7. Let it sit for about 5 minutes before serving. My shortcut: I usually just shred a rotisserie chicken for this. If I have leftover rotisserie chicken in the fridge, even better. It makes this ridiculously easy. Creamy Chicken Tostones 😍 This recipe is a 10/10, and I’m already thinking about making it again next week. 😋 Ingredients:  * 2 chicken breasts, cut into bite-size pieces * ½ teaspoon each salt, black pepper, garlic powder, onion powder, smoked paprika, and oregano * Oil, for cooking the chicken and frying the plantains * 2 green plantains, peeled and cut into chunks * ⅓ red bell pepper, sliced * ⅓ green bell pepper, sliced * ⅓ white onion, sliced * 3 garlic cloves, minced * 1 tablespoon butter * 2 tablespoons chopped fresh cilantro, plus more for topping * 1 tablespoon tomato paste * 1/2  chicken bouillon * 1½ cups heavy cream, or adjust to your preferred amount of sauce * ⅓ cup Parmesan cheese (add more if you want to) Instructions: 1. Season the chicken with salt, black pepper, garlic powder, onion powder, smoked paprika, and oregano. 2. Heat a little oil in a pan over high heat. Add the chicken and sear until browned and cooked through, about 5–7 minutes, depending on the size of the pieces. Remove from the pan and set aside. 3. Heat oil in a separate pan over medium-low heat. Fry the plantain chunks until tender but not too browned. Remove and flatten each piece with a tostonera or the bottom of a cup. 4. Raise the heat and fry the flattened plantains until crispy and golden. Transfer to a paper towel-lined plate and sprinkle with salt right away. 5. In a pan, heat a little oil and melt the butter. Add the peppers and onion and cook for about a minute. Add the garlic and cilantro and cook for another 1–2 minutes. 6. Stir in the tomato paste and chicken bouillon. Add the heavy cream and Parmesan, then stir until the sauce is smooth and creamy. 7. Add the chicken back to the pan and toss to coat. Taste and adjust the salt as needed. Finish with cilantro. 8. Spoon the creamy chicken over the tostones, or serve it on the side.
